description: This provides a continuation of work done in MA2288 and the project should be of two semester's duration. Please see section 4.4.3. This is a UROPS course enhanced with the Research Experience Programme, where students attend seminars and workshops, access writing consultations, receive a grant to do independent research, and present their findings at a conference.
preclusion: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN must not have completed MA2289 at a grade of at least D

prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES (1) MA1101R:D, MA2001:D)
